errata.corrected_text: In particular, in the aligned case ||D0C||^2 = m_1 kappa_1 the criterion-I inequality holds iff m_1 > m_2, so m_1 > m_2 implies STRICT. If m_1 = m_2 (then M = mI and the data are automatically aligned), item 5 gives STRICT when CC^T is anisotropic and item 6 gives EQUALITY when CC^T = kappa I. Hence, in the aligned case, the gap is STRICT unless both D0^T D0 and CC^T are multiples of I.
